$comment: inkflo craft taxonomy. Our own wording, derived from the craft literature (McCloud, Mateu-Mestre) and standard comics practice. No source text is reproduced. IDs are stable; labels are UI strings.

sources.title: Making Comics
sources.author: Scott McCloud
sources.use: panel choices, transitions, word-image relations, clarity

sources.title: Framed Ink
sources.author: Marcos Mateu-Mestre
sources.use: composition, staging, continuity, panel and page choreography

panelChoices.label: Frame
panelChoices.hint: How close, from where, in what shape?

panelChoices.label: Image
panelChoices.hint: What is drawn, and how is it rendered?

panelChoices.label: Word
panelChoices.hint: What do words add or replace?

panelChoices.label: Flow
panelChoices.hint: How does the eye travel to the next panel?

transitions.label: Moment to moment
transitions.hint: A small step in time; holds a beat.

transitions.label: Action to action
transitions.hint: One action to the next; the workhorse.

transitions.label: Subject to subject
transitions.hint: Same scene, different subject; needs reader fluency.

transitions.label: Scene to scene
transitions.hint: A jump in place or time; compress.

transitions.label: Aspect to aspect
transitions.hint: Wander the scene; mood and place.

shots.label: Establishing
shots.hint: Where and when; the world first.

shots.label: Detail
shots.hint: A hand, an eye, an object; emphasis.

wordImage.label: Word-specific
wordImage.hint: Pictures illustrate; words carry the meaning.

wordImage.label: Picture-specific
wordImage.hint: Words are a soundtrack; the image carries it.

wordImage.label: Parallel
wordImage.hint: Words and pictures take different tracks.

wordImage.label: Montage
wordImage.hint: Words become part of the picture.

checks.label: Reading order
checks.rule: Eye reaches panels and balloons in the intended order.

checks.label: Balloon before speaker
checks.rule: A balloon is not read before the panel that introduces its speaker.

checks.label: Tail points at the speaker
checks.rule: Every speech tail resolves to a character in the panel.

checks.label: Words repeat the picture
checks.rule: Flag panels where the caption describes exactly what is drawn.

checks.label: Screen direction
checks.rule: A subject keeps its left/right facing across consecutive panels unless a panel establishes the change.

checks.label: Eyeline match
checks.rule: Look directions across a cut plausibly meet.

checks.label: Silhouette
checks.rule: The panel reads as a shape when filled black.

checks.label: One focal point
checks.rule: A single dominant area; competing centres are flagged.

checks.label: Negative space
checks.rule: Empty area is doing work, not left over.

checks.label: Big / medium / small
checks.rule: Shapes are not all one size.

checks.label: Transition rhythm
checks.rule: Flag runs of the same transition type; suggest a change.

checks.label: Reveal distance
checks.rule: Setup and payoff are not so far apart that the reader loses the thread.
